text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breath turning white in the cold wind...
Such was a certain day in December.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Out of the blue, Air Groove called me to come to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wondering what could have happened, I hurried over—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Trainer's office had undergone a drastic transformation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh. Judging by your shock,
you had indeed forgotten what day it is, hadn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I was surprised to hear Air Groove cheerily saying
"Merry Christmas," but setting that aside—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I finished it this morning. It's a bit intricate,
but it captures the mood quite well, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is not just the decorations.
We have prepared food and cake as well—everything is in order.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Christmas is one of the premier events of the year.
If we do not see it through properly, we cannot end the year on a high note.
choice_data_list: I feel bad having you prepare everything...
I feel bad having you prepare everything...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry.
This is something I am doing because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, today—
doubles as a sort of reward for your hard work.
choice_data_list: A treat for our hard work?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, we haven't properly held a victory celebration up until now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Taking this opportunity, today's plan is to look back on each other's past year
and show appreciation for our respective hard work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —That would be more like us.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this doubles as a Christmas and year-end appreciation party.
I will not let you do any more work today, so brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Before we begin this meeting,
there is something I must have you say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You should already know what needs to be said, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas once again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, I shared a feast with Air Groove and looked back on the past year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking back, it truly was a fulfilling year... It turned out to be a Christmas that made me realize just that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Air Groove and I sat down to a feast and reflected on the past year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fun times flew by in the blink of an eye,
and just as the party was in full swing—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, take this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's a Christmas present, as well as a token of my appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the package, inside was...
a portable-looking leather notebook.
choice_data_list: Thanks! I'll take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please do.
It is an organizer tailor-made for you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Open up the calendar section and look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening it as told...
every single date lists anniversaries and events
in meticulous detail.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For someone who tends to forget events all the time, this ought to be just right, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year, you should make use of that
and dedicate yourself to your daily efforts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With this planner, I'm sure next year will be another fulfilling year with Air Groove—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight became a Christmas where
such warm feelings could be embraced.
